title: CLI JSON output envelope
description: Stable envelope for every `citable <command> --json` output. Consumers read `citable_output_schema` for envelope compatibility and read command data from `result`. The envelope version changes only on breaking envelope changes; command payloads evolve backward-compatibly inside result.

citable_output_schema.description: Envelope contract version. 1.0 is the initial stable contract.

tool_version.description: Citable package version that produced the output.

command.description: Top-level command that produced this output.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the output was generated.

result.description: Command-specific payload. Structure is defined per command and evolves backward-compatibly within an envelope major version.
